scripts.build: ng build storefront && ng build admin
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('[Phase 0.1] No unit tests yet - Vitest arrives in Sub-Phase 0.8.')"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/storefront/tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.app.json && npm run typecheck:libs
scripts.typecheck:libs: tsc --noEmit -p libs/api/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/auth/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/ui/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/i18n/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/theming/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/models/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/utils/tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:format && npm run lint:boundaries
scripts.lint:format: prettier --check angular.json package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs apps/storefront/tsconfig.app.json apps/admin/tsconfig.app.json apps/storefront/src apps/admin/src libs/api libs/auth libs/ui libs/i18n libs/theming libs/models libs/utils
scripts.format:check: prettier --check angular.json package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs apps/storefront/tsconfig.app.json apps/admin/tsconfig.app.json apps/storefront/src apps/admin/src libs/api libs/auth libs/ui libs/i18n libs/theming libs/models libs/utils
scripts.test:unit: node -e "console.log('[Phase 0.1] Vitest not configured yet - planned for Sub-Phase 0.8.')"
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "console.log('[Phase 0.1] Playwright not configured yet - planned for Sub-Phase 0.8.')"
